lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section with slight compression towards the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One visible Y-shaped bifurcation in the mid-ventral region where two lines merge into a single superior segment.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Several lines on the anterior and posterior edges of the torso terminate prematurely as dashed segments before reaching the dorsal or ventral extremities.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 3 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lateral surface of the posterior haunch/upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the upper-most section of the hind limb exhibit a near-horizontal spatial alignment.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white chevron on the nasal bridge, a single white circular spot on the lower cheek, and white transversal bands on the lower legs.
